tools.description: Record facts with evidence and labels (`memories`), link stored memories (`relations`) or attach search renderings (`search_summaries`): the usual writer. Guide topic: write.

tools.description: Compare explicitly selected abouts: shared scopes, declared relations, tensions and proposed cross-about equivalences.
tools.name: kmp_relate

tools.description: Navigate an about's history on one clock (rewind, forward, goto, near): what changed, the latest, or the state at a date.

move.description: rewind/forward take from or interval; goto takes at; near takes around.

tools.name: kmp_time

tools.description: Find the evidenced path from a stored memory to known destinations (`to`), or the evidence for required roles from that seed (`search.seek`). Guide topic: audit.
tools.name: kmp_trace

tools.description: Read one stored memory or write receipt in full, with its evidence and links, before relying on it. Guide topic: audit.
tools.name: kmp_inspect

tools.description: Add or take off the labels of one stored memory without rewriting its text.

actor.description: Writer name. Omitted: the MCP client name.

tools.description: Store your own compact card for one stored body, so later reads can show the card instead of the whole body.

actor.description: Writer name. Omitted: the MCP client name.

actor.description: Writer name. Omitted: the MCP client name.
